scene firstwinter1
Maya was right about things restarting a little...different than normally this time.
lines.zh: Maya 说得没错，这次重启之后，事情的开局跟平常……有点不一样。

lines.en: Instead of being sent back in time or back in physical-location or whatever happened during my first trip into the ether (?), we just opened our eyes and saw snow.
lines.zh: 我们没有被送回过去，也没有被送回某个物理位置——或者我第一次飘进以太（？）时发生的随便什么——我们只是睁开眼，看见了雪。

lines.en: The lack of anything dramatic happening made the fact that we still had our hands linked together relatively awkward for the both of us.
lines.zh: 因为没发生什么戏剧性的事，我们俩的手还牵在一起，这件事对彼此就变得相当尴尬。

lines.en: Which probably explains why Maya quickly yanked her hands away from me the second her eyes opened.
lines.zh: 这大概也解释了为什么 Maya 一睁眼就立刻把手从我这里抽走。

lines.en: It seems she was right about things going smoothly this time.
lines.zh: 看来她说这次会很顺利，是对的。

lines.en: Even if I haven’t seen anyone else in the streets on the way back from[school], I have a pretty positive outlook for what’s to come when we get home.
lines.zh: 尽管从[school]回来的路上我在街上一个别人都没看见，但对我们到家之后会发生什么，我的展望还是相当乐观的。

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: Did I forget to mention?
lines.zh: 我忘了说吗？

lines.en: That “important matter” we needed to attend to after our reset was nothing more than Maya sleeping over at the house with Ami and Ayane.
lines.zh: 那件我们重置后需要处理的「要事」，不过就是 Maya 来家里和 Ami、Ayane 一起过夜而已。

lines.en: And here I was thinking something interesting was going to happen.
lines.zh: 而我本来还以为会有什么有意思的事发生。

lines.en: : I knew it would be cold but I didn’t actually think it would snow right away.
lines.zh: : 我知道会冷，但真没想到会这么快就下雪。

lines.en: : It normally takes at least a few days for that to happen.
lines.zh: : 通常至少要过几天才会下。

lines.en: : I guess it really {i}is{/i} good you came dressed for the occasion after all.
lines.zh: : 看来你为这场合穿得对，{i}确实{/i}是件好事。

lines.en: : Aren’t you cold in shorts, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你穿短裤不冷吗？

lines.en: scene firstwinter2
: Not really.
lines.zh: : 不太冷。

lines.en: : Neither the cold nor the heat bother me all that much.
lines.zh: : 冷也好热也好，都不怎么困扰我。

lines.en: : I do prefer things to be like this, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我确实更喜欢现在这样。

lines.en: : Not having to put my hair into a ponytail saves me several seconds every morning.
lines.zh: : 不用把头发扎成马尾，每天早上能省下好几秒钟。

lines.en: : Or you could just not put your hair into a ponytail during the summer.
lines.zh: : 或者你夏天干脆别扎马尾不就行了。

lines.en: : My neck would get hot.
lines.zh: : 我的脖子会热。

lines.en: : But the heat doesn’t bother you all that much.
lines.zh: : 可你又说热不怎么困扰你。

lines.en: : Because I put my hair into a ponytail.
lines.zh: : 因为我把头发扎起来了啊。

lines.en: : You really don’t understand how girls work, do you?
lines.zh: : 你真的完全不懂女生的构造，是吧？

lines.en: : I guess not.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : I really do wish you would have informed me about this beforehand, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我真希望你事先跟我说这事。

lines.en: : I could have tried out one of those thicker T-shirts I bought at the mall the other day.
lines.zh: : 我就能试试前几天在商场买的那几件厚一点的 T 恤了。

lines.en: scene firstwinter3
: What color did you go with this time? Grey?
lines.zh: : 这次你挑了什么颜色？灰色？

lines.en: : Same as always then.
lines.zh: : 那还是跟以前一样。

lines.en: : I guess some things never change.
lines.zh: : 我想有些事是永远都不会变的。

lines.en: I want to say it’s some sort of huge revelation that the original Sensei also chose the color grey but, in all actuality, it’s probably only due to the fact that there was a sale on that particular color the day I was in the store.
lines.zh: 我本想说，原来那位 Sensei 也选了灰色，算是个重大发现；不过实际上，大概只是因为我去店里那天那个颜色在打折罢了。

lines.en: Not like the selection had all that much to choose from to begin with, but-
lines.zh: 再说本来可选的颜色也没多少，不过——

lines.en: Well, I guess things like that don’t even matter.
lines.zh: 嗯，我想这种事根本不重要。

lines.en: I have nothing to gain from looking into the way the last person who used this body handled it.
lines.zh: 去追究上一个用这副身体的人怎么处理它，我什么也得不到。

lines.en: They’re free to wear whatever color they want wherever they are now.
lines.zh: 他们现在在哪儿、想穿什么颜色，随他们去吧。

lines.en: And I’ll continue to choose things that reflect how little I have to share with the world.
lines.zh: 而我会继续挑那些能反映我有多么没什么可分享给这个世界的东西。

lines.en: : Oh. We need to stop somewhere on the way back.
lines.zh: : 哦。我们回去的路上得在什么地方停一下。

lines.en: : What? Where? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？哪儿？为什么？

lines.en: : Convenience store.
lines.zh: : 便利店。

lines.en: : We need an excuse for why we’re showing up together at the same time.
lines.zh: : 我们需要一个借口，解释为什么我们会同时一起出现。

lines.en: : I didn’t even think of that.
lines.zh: : 我都没想到这一点。

lines.en: : You never do.
lines.zh: : 你从来想不到。

lines.en: : I’ve done this a few times now.
lines.zh: : 这种事我都做过好几次了。

lines.en: : I’m surprised even an excuse would make them feel normal about this.
lines.zh: : 我很惊讶，光是一个借口就能让她们觉得这事正常。

lines.en: : Do you feel out of place?
lines.zh: : 你觉得不自在吗？

lines.en: : You mean walking back to my house in the middle of the night with you? Yeah, kind of.
lines.zh: : 你是指大半夜跟你一起走回我家？对，有点。

lines.en: scene firstwinter4
: But just think of all the cute girls waiting for you when you get home.
lines.zh: : 不过想想回家时等着你的那些可爱女孩吧。

lines.en: : There are only two cute girls waiting for me right now.
lines.zh: : 现在等我的可爱女孩只有两个。

lines.en: : Yes, but that’s two more than you deserve.
lines.zh: : 是没错，可那也比你应得的多两个。

lines.en: : Thanks, Maya.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Maya。

lines.en: She was right when she said some things never change.
lines.zh: 她说有些事永远都不会变，说得没错。

lines.en: But, strangely enough, that makes me all the more comfortable right now.
lines.zh: 可奇怪的是，这反而让我此刻更自在了。

lines.en: I recall a conversation we had in the past about how I would act if she randomly turned into a completely different person one day.
lines.zh: 我想起我们以前有过一次对话，聊的是如果她某天突然变成一个完全不同的人，我会怎么做。

lines.en: I’m glad to know that hasn’t happened.
lines.zh: 我很高兴知道那并没有发生。

lines.en: And I hope it will continue to not happen.
lines.zh: 也希望它继续不要发生。

lines.en: For my sake-
lines.zh: 为了我自己——

lines.en: And hers, I guess.
lines.zh: 还有她吧，我想。

lines.en: Though, I guess it might be better for her in the long run to not have to endure something like this anymore.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，从长远看，她不用再忍受这种事，也许对她更好。

lines.en: scene black
Maya and I stop at a convenience store close to my house that Ami and I visit in the morning sometimes.
lines.zh: 我和 Maya 在我家附近的一家便利店停下，我和 Ami 有时候早上会去那儿。

lines.en: We grab a few snacks and drinks and other assorted items to make it look like we came here on purpose and are not returning empty-handed.
lines.zh: 我们拿了些零食、饮料和其他杂七杂八的东西，好让它看起来像是专程来的，而不是空着手回来。

lines.en: Ami’s already suspicious of the relationship between Ayane and me, so having her be suspicious with Maya next would just be way too bothersome.
lines.zh: Ami 本来就对 Ayane 和我之间的关系起了疑心，要是她再对 Maya 起疑心，那就太麻烦了。

lines.en: And Maya would probably vomit at even the slightest insinuation of something going on between the two of us.
lines.zh: 而只要稍微暗示一点我们两个之间有什么，Maya 大概就会吐出来。

lines.en: {i}A thousand snow-covered footprints later...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}走过千万个覆雪的脚印之后……{/i}

lines.en: : I’m home.
lines.zh: : 我回来了。

lines.en: I quickly kick my shoes off at the door and place all of the bags we brought back from the convenience store on the kitchen counter.
lines.zh: 我迅速在门口踢掉鞋，把我们从便利店带回来的所有袋子放到厨房台面上。

lines.en: scene firstwinter5
The sound of hurried footsteps follow as Ami and Ayane run up to me the second the door opens.
lines.zh: 门一开，紧接着就是一阵急促的脚步声，Ami 和 Ayane 朝我跑了过来。

lines.en: And Ami’s hair is...very long when it’s down.
lines.zh: 而 Ami 的头发披下来的时候……非常长。

lines.en: Well, it’s very long when it’s in twintails as well. But {i}this{/i} is just intimidating.
lines.zh: 嗯，扎成双马尾的时候也很长。但{i}这样{/i}就有点吓人了。

lines.en: Maybe I should take her to get a haircut soon?
lines.zh: 也许我该尽快带她去剪个头发？

lines.en: : Welcome home! I missed you!
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家！我好想你！

lines.en: : I missed you too, Sensei! I almost left when I found out you weren’t here, but that would have just been plain rude to Ami.
lines.zh: : 我也好想你，Sensei！发现你不在的时候我差点就走了，不过那样对 Ami 就太失礼了。

lines.en: : Sensei, make sure you don’t look at Ayane at all tonight.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你今晚千万别看 Ayane。

lines.en: : She keeps her hoodie zipped down so you’ll look at her chest. Isn’t that super perverted and not at all a desirable quality in a girl?
lines.zh: : 她把帽衫拉链拉开，好让你看她的胸。是不是超级变态，而且完全不是一个女孩子该有的品质？

lines.en: : Sensei. Quick. Look down here. Don’t let Ami’s words distract you from the true prize.
lines.zh: : Sensei。快。看这边。别让 Ami 的话把你的注意力从真正的奖赏上引开。

lines.en: : Uhh...I’m here too, you know.
lines.zh: : 呃……我也在这儿呢，你们知道吧。

lines.en: scene firstwinter6
: Oh. Hi, Maya.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗨，Maya。

lines.en: : What do you mean, “Hi, Maya?”
lines.zh: : 「嗨，Maya」是什么意思？

lines.en: : It’s a greeting. You say that to people when you are...well, you know, greeting them.
lines.zh: : 那是问候啊。你对别人……嗯，你知道的，打招呼的时候就说这个。

lines.en: : Why is his greeting so much better than mine?
lines.zh: : 为什么他打招呼的待遇比我好那么多？

lines.en: : I’m just more popular than you, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概我就是比你受欢迎吧。

lines.en: scene firstwinter7
: Well that just doesn’t make any sense at all.
lines.zh: : 这完全说不通啊。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Maya. I still like you.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Maya。我还是喜欢你的。

lines.en: : If Hell was real I’d tell you to go there right now.
lines.zh: : 要是地狱真的存在，我现在就叫你滚去那儿。

lines.en: : Since it’s not, are you going to come up with a better insult? Or are you just going to call me disgusting again?
lines.zh: : 既然不存在，那你是要编个更好的骂人话？还是又要叫我恶心？

lines.en: : I’m too tired to insult anyone right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在累得没力气骂人了。

lines.en: : Please excuse me while I go put my pajamas on.
lines.zh: : 失陪一下，我去换睡衣。

lines.en: : Must I say that several more times at a higher volume so you don’t enter the room and say something like, “Oh, I didn’t hear you?”
lines.zh: : 我要不要再用更大的音量多说几遍，免得你走进房间来一句「哦，我没听见」？

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Maya! We’ll keep him out here. You can go get changed.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Maya！我们会把他拦在外面的。你去换衣服吧。

lines.en: scene firstwinter8
: Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : Now, please excuse me.
lines.zh: : 那么，失陪了。

lines.en: scene firstwinter9
Maya storms past me and into Ami’s room, leaving me alone with two girls who are likely going to spend the rest of the night fighting over me.
lines.zh: Maya 从我身边冲过去，进了 Ami 的房间，留下我和两个大概会为了争我而闹上一整晚的女孩独处。

lines.en: My life really is difficult at times.
lines.zh: 我的人生有时候真是艰难。

lines.en: scene firstwinter10
: What’s her deal?
lines.zh: : 她怎么回事？

lines.en: : You didn’t do anything weird to her while you guys were out, did you?
lines.zh: : 你们出去的时候，你没对她做什么奇怪的事吧？

lines.en: : To Maya? No. She’d erase me.
lines.zh: : 对 Maya？没有。她会把我抹掉的。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: : I don’t think you did anything weird, Sensei. Maya just gets really angry and confused whenever anyone shows affection for you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你没做什么奇怪的事，Sensei。只要有人对你表示好感，Maya 就会变得特别生气又困惑。

lines.en: : No wonder she’s always so uptight. I like to think I’ve become pretty well liked over the last several months.
lines.zh: : 难怪她总是那么紧绷。我倒是觉得这几个月下来我已经挺招人喜欢的了。

lines.en: : Last several {i}years{/i} in our cases. Ami and I like you more than anyone, I think. Ami being in second place, of course.
lines.zh: : 在我们这儿是{i}好几年{/i}。我想，我和 Ami 比任何人都更喜欢你。当然，Ami 是第二名。

lines.en: scene firstwinter11
: What were you guys even doing out there in the snow?
lines.zh: : 你们俩在大雪里到底出去干什么了？

lines.en: : Are you really going to ignore what Ayane said just now? I thought that would set you off.
lines.zh: : 你真打算无视 Ayane 刚才说的话？我以为那会让你炸毛。

lines.en: : Ayane? Is she here?
lines.zh: : Ayane？她在这儿吗？

lines.en: scene firstwinter12
: Hey! Being ignored hurts even worse than being insulted.
lines.zh: : 嘿！被无视比被骂还伤人。

lines.en: : I bumped into Maya at the convenience store and wound up being forced to carry all of the snacks she bought for you guys back here.
lines.zh: : 我在便利店撞见了 Maya，结果被迫把她给你们买的零食一路拎回来。

lines.en: : And when I say {i}she{/i} bought them I mean she made {i}me{/i} buy them as payment for me inconveniencing her by crossing her path.
lines.zh: : 而我说{i}她{/i}买的，其实是她让{i}我{/i}买的，作为我挡了她路的赔偿。

lines.en: I find it slightly shocking how easy it is to make up a believable lie about where Maya and I were today- even if it was slightly rehearsed.
lines.zh: 我有点惊讶，编一个关于我和 Maya 今天去哪儿了的可信谎言居然这么容易——哪怕这借口是事先排练过的。

lines.en: : So you’ve been here since[school] ended?
lines.zh: : 那你们从[school]放学后就一直在这儿？

lines.en: : School? What are you talking about? It's Christmas Eve and we're on winter break until Monday.
lines.zh: : School？你在说什么？今天是平安夜，我们放假放到周一。

lines.en: : And even if we weren't, it's still Saturday. How do you not know that?
lines.zh: : 就算不是，今天也是周六。你怎么连这个都不知道？

lines.en: scene firstwinter13
: Wait?! Did they change the schedule?! When are we supposed to go back?!
lines.zh: : 等等？！他们改时间表了？！我们到底什么时候回去？！

lines.en: : Have you been going to[school] this whole time and not telling me about it?! Is this a test?!
lines.zh: : 你这段时间一直去[school]了却不告诉我？！这是考验吗？！

lines.en: : What’s going on?!
lines.zh: : 到底怎么回事？！

lines.en: That’s...strange.
lines.zh: 这……有点奇怪。

lines.en: I’ve never had to deal with winter break before on account of winter...not even being a thing until right now.
lines.zh: 我以前从没经历过寒假，因为冬天……直到现在才存在。

lines.en: Were we really supposed to start here? Or was this some sort of accident?
lines.zh: 我们真的该从这里开始吗？还是说这是某种意外？

lines.en: : I’m sure the schedule hasn’t changed. Just feeling a little out of it right now.
lines.zh: : 我肯定时间表没变。只是现在有点恍惚。

lines.en: : Is it from the cold? Do you need me to warm you up?
lines.zh: : 是因为冷吗？要我给你暖暖吗？

lines.en: : Come, Sensei! I’ll warm the bath for you!
lines.zh: : 来吧，Sensei！我去给你放洗澡水！

lines.en: : I can warm the bath myself, thanks.
lines.zh: : 洗澡水我自己会放，谢谢。

lines.en: scene firstwinter14
: Boo...
: Maybe you should head to sleep early if you’re not feeling good?
lines.zh: : 你要是不舒服，要不要早点睡？

lines.en: : We were probably just gonna stay up and watch movies or something anyway.
lines.zh: : 我们大概也就打算熬夜看看电影什么的。

lines.en: : Yeah, maybe.
lines.zh: : 嗯，也许吧。

lines.en: I do feel extremely tired, but I imagine that has less to do with the after-effects of time travel and more to do with walking several miles through snow in my normal T-shirt instead of the thicker one.
lines.zh: 我确实觉得累得要命，不过我想这与其说是时间旅行的后遗症，不如说是我穿着平常那件 T 恤而不是厚那件、在雪里走了好几英里的结果。

lines.en: I feel like winter will be enjoyable in the long run, though. I’d much rather deal with walking through the snow than dodging rays of sun for days at a time.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得从长远来看冬天会挺舒服的。比起一连几天躲太阳，我更愿意在雪里走。

lines.en: : Besides, we need to start preparing for the party early tomorrow morning and you’ll probably complain if you don’t get enough rest.
lines.zh: : 再说，明天一早我们就得开始为派对做准备，你要是休息不够肯定会抱怨。

lines.en: : Actually, you’ll probably complain no matter what. But at least Makoto is handling the hotel and stuff.
lines.zh: : 其实不管怎样你都会抱怨。不过至少酒店什么的由 Makoto 在负责。

lines.en: Just before I decide to go to sleep, I’m hit with an abundance of strange information.
lines.zh: 就在我决定去睡之前，一大堆奇怪的信息砸了过来。

lines.en: : So, Makoto is okay now?
lines.zh: : 那么，Makoto 现在没事了？

lines.en: scene firstwinter15
: Was she...ever {i}not{/i} okay?
lines.zh: : 她……{i}曾经{/i}有事过吗？

lines.en: : She’s seemed pretty normal to me lately. But I guess Sensei knows her a little better than either of us do.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她最近挺正常的。不过我想 Sensei 比我们两个都更了解她一点。

lines.en: : She hasn’t seemed different to either of you lately?
lines.zh: : 你们俩最近都没觉得她有什么不一样？

lines.en: : Different? No. Strict and annoying? Yes.
lines.zh: : 不一样？没有。严厉又烦人？有。

lines.en: : Huh...
Did changing where we are in time somehow...{i}fix{/i} Makoto?
lines.zh: 改变了我们在时间上的位置，不知怎么就{i}修好了{/i} Makoto？

lines.en: That’s good, I guess, but...
lines.zh: 这大概是好事吧，不过……

lines.en: I feel like now I won’t ever figure out why she got all weird in the first place.
lines.zh: 我觉得这样一来，我永远也搞不清她当初为什么会变得那么怪了。

lines.en: I’ll have to talk to her at the-
lines.zh: 我得在——跟她谈谈。

lines.en: : ...Party.
lines.zh: : ……派对上。

lines.en: : Hm? What about the party?
lines.zh: : 嗯？派对怎么了？

lines.en: : Would you mind explaining to me what this party is about again?...
lines.zh: : 你能不能再给我讲讲这个派对是怎么回事？……

lines.en: scene firstwinter16
: Oh! Let me!
lines.zh: : 哦！我来说！

lines.en: : Since the beach trip was such a success and the Halloween party was pretty awesome as well, we’re going to throw a class Christmas party!
lines.zh: : 因为海边之行大获成功，万圣节派对也相当棒，所以我们打算办一场班级圣诞派对！

lines.en: : Like Ami said before, we’re going to have it in a hotel and everyone has already confirmed that they’re coming.
lines.zh: : 就像 Ami 刚才说的，我们会在一家酒店里办，而且大家都已经确认会来了。

lines.en: : Even Yumi is going to be there, so it’s already a pretty big deal.
lines.zh: : 连 Yumi 都会去，所以这已经算是件大事了。

lines.en: : And when you say {i}everyone{/i} does that include Molly and Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 你说的{i}大家{/i}，包括 Molly 和 Tsuneyo 吗？

lines.en: scene firstwinter17
I go out on a limb and try to find out even more about what’s going on in this version of Kumon-mi, potentially exposing myself in the process.
lines.zh: 我冒险去打探更多关于这个版本的 Kumon-mi 正在发生什么，过程中可能会暴露自己。

lines.en: If this is a timeline where those two haven’t joined our class, I’ll probably just sound like a perverted teacher who has his eye on students from other classes.
lines.zh: 如果这条时间线里她们两个还没加入我们班，我大概听起来就像个盯着别班学生的变态老师。

lines.en: But at this point, I don’t think something like that would even make these girls think any less of me.
lines.zh: 不过事到如今，我觉得这种事大概也不会让这些女孩对我有任何改观了。

lines.en: : Well, I know those two are weird but...I can’t see any reason why they wouldn’t come to the party if they’re part of the class.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我知道那两个人是挺怪的，不过……只要她们是我们班的，我想不出她们有什么理由不来派对。

lines.en: Good...
The idea of them not being around was weighing on me more than I ever expected it to.
lines.zh: 她们不在身边的这个念头，给我带来的压力比我预想的要大得多。

lines.en: But I guess even someone like me can succumb to the emotions of [teenage]girls when they break down in my arms about how much they don’t want to leave me.
lines.zh: 不过我想，连我这样的人，也会在[teenage]女孩在我怀里崩溃、说她们有多不想离开我的时候，败下阵来。

lines.en: : So, just to recap...
lines.zh: : 那么，总结一下……

lines.en: : Makoto is fine, Molly and Tsuneyo are still my students, and we are having a Christmas party in a hotel room.
lines.zh: : Makoto 没事了，Molly 和 Tsuneyo 还是我的学生，我们要在酒店房间里办圣诞派对。

lines.en: : Uhh...yes?
: Why are you being so weird about it?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么奇怪？

lines.en: : Is there anything else I need to know?
lines.zh: : 还有什么我需要知道的吗？

lines.en: scene firstwinter18
: Uhh...
scene firstwinter17
: I...love you?
lines.zh: : 我……爱你？

lines.en: : I love you as well. It would be good for you to know that.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。你知道这一点挺好的。

lines.en: : I meant anything regarding our immediate future...
lines.zh: : 我是说关于我们眼前的未来……

lines.en: : Uhh...
if ayanelust10 == False:
scene firstwinter19
: Oh! Kirin is coming to the party as well.
lines.zh: : 哦！Kirin 也会来派对。

lines.en: : But other than that, I don’t think there’s anything important you need to know.
lines.zh: : 不过除此之外，我想没什么重要的事需要你知道了。

lines.en: else:
scene firstwinter20
: Oh! Kirin is coming to the party as well.
lines.zh: : 哦！Kirin 也会来派对。

lines.en: : But other than that, I don’t think there’s anything important you need to know.
lines.zh: : 不过除此之外，我想没什么重要的事需要你知道了。

lines.en: That...might be uncomfortable for some people.
lines.zh: 那……对某些人来说可能会不太舒服。

lines.en: : Got it. Thanks for letting me know.
lines.zh: : 知道了。谢谢你们告诉我。

lines.en: scene black
A Christmas party, huh?
lines.zh: 圣诞派对，是吧？

lines.en: Can’t say I didn’t see something like that coming sooner or later.
lines.zh: 不能说我完全没料到迟早会有这么一回事。

lines.en: Did I expect it to be the first thing that happened to me after winter’s long-awaited arrival?
lines.zh: 可我有没有想到，它会是冬天千呼万唤始出来之后，发生在我身上的第一件事？

lines.en: Nope. Not one bit.
lines.zh: 没有。一点都没有。

lines.en: But, in true Sensei-fashion, I’m not going to complain about seeing all of my students together in one place.
lines.zh: 不过，以 Sensei 一贯的作风，我可不会抱怨能在一个地方见到我所有的学生。

lines.en: I’m sure that whatever comes next will be a good start to this brand new cycle in a life I never dreamed I’d have.
lines.zh: 我确信接下来发生的任何事，都会是我从没梦想过会拥有的人生里，这个全新循环的良好开端。

lines.en: {i}Congratulations on making it to the second chapter of Lessons in Love!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜你进入《Lessons in Love》的第二章！{/i}

lines.en: {i}The following events are part of a special event chain and will play from start to finish in succession.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}以下事件属于一条特别事件链，将从头到尾依次播放。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You will not have free-time to use during this chain.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在这条事件链期间你将没有自由时间可用。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Once it is complete, you’ll be free to act as you please once more and-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一旦它结束，你就能重新自由行动，而且——{/i}

lines.en: {i}Since it’s officially Winter, expect a few changes around the city!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}既然已经正式入冬，城里会出现一些变化！{/i}

lines.en: {i}That’s all for now...but have a Merry Christmas or Happy Hannukah or whatever other holiday you celebrate!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那么就先说这些吧……祝你圣诞快乐，或者光明节快乐，或者随便你过什么节！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Cherish your loved ones, for you never know when something horrible may happen to them!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}珍惜你爱的人吧，因为你永远不知道什么时候会有可怕的事降临在他们身上！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Roughly thirty minutes later...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}大约三十分钟后……{/i}

lines.en: scene firstwinter21
: Mm...Sen...sei...
lines.zh: : 嗯……Sen……sei……

lines.en: : Weren’t they planning on watching movies all night?
lines.zh: : 她们不是打算通宵看电影吗？

lines.en: : And where is Maya?
lines.zh: : 还有 Maya 在哪儿？

lines.en: : She went to get changed like forty-five minutes-
lines.zh: : 她去换衣服了，都四十五分钟——

lines.en: scene firstwinter22
: Sorry. I passed out as soon as I got dressed and-
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我一穿上衣服就睡着了，然后——

lines.en: scene firstwinter23
: What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？

lines.en: : Oh, you know. Just hanging out.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。就随便待着。

lines.en: : Did you drug them?
lines.zh: : 你把她们迷晕了？

lines.en: : Do you think I’d need to?...
lines.zh: : 你觉得我需要吗？……

lines.en: : Unfortunately not. But that doesn’t make this any less weird for me.
lines.zh: : 不幸的是不需要。不过这也没让我觉得这事不奇怪。

lines.en: : I can’t fall back asleep so soon after taking a nap. What am I supposed to do now?
lines.zh: : 我刚睡过午觉，没法这么快再睡着。那我现在该干什么？

lines.en: : Want to hang out?
lines.zh: : 想一起待会儿吗？

lines.en: : I’m suddenly feeling very tired again.
lines.zh: : 我突然又觉得好困。

lines.en: : Goodnight.
lines.zh: : 晚安。

lines.en: scene firstwinter24
Yup.
lines.zh: 是啊。

lines.en: Can’t say I didn’t see that coming.
lines.zh: 不能说我完全没料到。

lines.en: scene black
I sit around for a few minutes longer before my leg and my arm fall asleep and I am forced to push the girls off of me.
lines.zh: 我又坐了几分钟，直到腿和胳膊都麻了，才被迫把女孩们从我身上推开。

lines.en: Neither of them wake up, so I carry them back to Ami’s bedroom and haphazardly toss both of them onto the bed, hoping that doing so doesn’t wake Maya up.
lines.zh: 她们两个都没醒，于是我把她们抱回 Ami 的卧室，胡乱地两个都扔到床上，希望这么做不会吵醒 Maya。

lines.en: Miraculously, it manages not to.
lines.zh: 奇迹般地，它没有。

lines.en: Even more miraculously, neither Ami nor Ayane wake up as well.
lines.zh: 更奇迹的是，Ami 和 Ayane 也都没醒。

lines.en: And before I know it, all three of them are passed out on the bed together in true [teenage]girl sleepover fashion.
lines.zh: 不知不觉间，她们三个就以最典型的[teenage]女孩留宿派对的方式，一起瘫在床上睡死了。

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
I walk into the bedroom, ready to call it a night after an {i}extremely{/i} eventful day.
lines.zh: 我走进卧室，准备在{i}极其{/i}充实的一天之后结束这一夜。

lines.en: But, surprisingly enough, nothing bad happened.
lines.zh: 但令人意外的是，什么坏事都没发生。

lines.en: And even though I spent most of the day with Maya, my head only hurts a little bit.
lines.zh: 而且尽管我这一天大部分时间都和 Maya 在一起，我的头也只是有点疼。

lines.en: I guess things are looking up after all.
lines.zh: 我想，事情总算是在往好的方向走了。

lines.en: scene black
But it’s only a matter of time before they get worse again.
lines.zh: 不过它们迟早又会变糟。

lines.en: That’s just how life is.
lines.zh: 人生就是这样。

lines.en: So I guess I’ll try to submerge myself in happy thoughts for the time being.
lines.zh: 所以我想，我暂且就让自己沉浸在快乐的念头里吧。

lines.en: And pretend that everything horrible is stuck somewhere deep underneath the ground.
lines.zh: 假装所有可怕的东西都被深埋在地底下的某个地方。
